content: {"like":["initial half hour nice work with the camera to make dull story palatable","casting is fine, especially Count Rostov","film seemed very Russian, very early 19th century, and created a society fearful of war","Natasha's first appearance"],"dislike":["did not like any of the main characters, now find them shallow","additional 45 minutes were dull","war sequences are tedious though lavish","whole thing seems like a big soap opera","Tolstoy's views on life are cracker barrel stuff and his theory of war is asinine","language setting issues with subtitles and dub","supplementary disc listed a Tolstoy documentary and a doc on the making of the film, but neither was there","overall film was a flop compared to earlier versions"]}
